title: Factory presets — categorized, gain-conscious
description:
Author factory preset JSON files under Resources/Presets/ that are categorized and gain-conscious per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §16. Useful starting points, not marketing demos.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §16 categories (Pre-Amp, Rhythm Post-Cab, Lead, Stereo Bus, Bass, Diagnostic) and naming spirit
- Source/Profiles.h placement/tuning ids and names from k.2 (category alignment)
- Source/StateManager.* factory load expectations (file names under Resources/Presets/, XML/ValueTree or JSON scheme used by listFactoryPresets/loadFactoryPreset — match whatever StateManager already documents; if dual format required, prefer JSON objects that StateManager can parse or that mirror APVTS property names)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h string IDs for parameters written into presets (read only)
- schema_version convention from StateManager

Create these factory presets (exact filenames):
1. Resources/Presets/PreAmp_TightSixString.json — Pre-Amp category; 6-string DI / tight input; modest input control, restrained mid push, gain-conscious (output/makeup near 0 dB unity intent)
2. Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernCleanup.json — Rhythm Post-Cab cleanup; palm-mute/low-mid stability hints via enabled modules and mild cuts; no extreme boosts
3. Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingFocus.json — Lead singing focus; upper-mid polish without harsh +12 dB spikes; optional note-follower friendly defaults if IDs exist
4. Resources/Presets/Bass_ClangControl.json — Bass clang control; low fundamental-friendly HPF/notches restraint; gain-conscious
5. Resources/Presets/Diag_FindResonances.json — Diagnostic find-resonances; analyzer-oriented / mild resonance-scan friendly defaults; not a loud rock preset

Each JSON must include at minimum:
- schema_version
- name / category fields
- placement profile and tuning references by name or index consistent with Profiles
- parameter map using ParameterIDs string keys with numeric/enum values inside valid ranges
- comments or meta field noting gain-conscious design (unity-ish outputGain / no stacked +20 dB stages)

Do not invent binary BinaryData codegen here (k.4 may juce_add_binary_data or path load). Do not edit C++ sources. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: Resources/Presets/PreAmp_TightSixString.json exists with Pre-Amp category metadata and schema_version
Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingFocus.json exists with Lead category metadata
Resources/Presets/Bass_ClangControl.json exists with Bass category metadata
Each preset references placement/tuning consistently with Profiles and uses ParameterIDs-style keys with in-range values and restrained output/makeup gain
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add extreme gain stacks or clip-marketing presets

allowed: JSON preset documents with schema_version, category, profile refs, parameter maps
conservative musically plausible default values within ParameterIDs ranges
forbidden: hidden non-user-visible processing flags outside documented params
